subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should this PR be ported to the current Dashboard header after the UI chrome refactor, or should the no-breadcrumb/header redesign direction own the linked workspace-context issue?
rationale: The behavior remains valuable and the linked issue is still open, but current main has refactored the affected UI surface and another maintainer PR proposes a different header direction that automation should not choose.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Reimplement this PR’s agent plus workspace breadcrumb on the current app-host/app-topbar/dashboard-header surface and keep optional switcher/toast/prefix ideas separate.

options.title: Adopt Replacement Header Direction
options.body: Let the newer header redesign define a different persistent workspace-context surface, then close or rework this PR around that decision.

options.title: Pause Until Header Scope Settles
options.body: Leave this PR open but blocked until maintainers decide the final dashboard header contract and linked-issue closure scope.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Reimplement this PR’s agent plus workspace breadcrumb on the current app-host/app-topbar/dashboard-header surface and keep optional switcher/toast/prefix ideas separate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current dashboard chrome refactor that determines where this UI context would now live.
